title: Kia Canada - Kia EV Charging Guide: NACS, CCS & Authorized Adapters
notes: Page body not readable by the fetcher; wording taken from a search excerpt: factory NACS ports on 2025+ EV6, 2026 EV9 and 2027 EV5; earlier Kia EVs with CCS1 ports, including Niro EV, need a Kia-approved NACS adapter. Corroborated by the Kia Canada press release of 2025-04-28 (relayed at https://finanzen.net/nachricht/aktien/kia-canada-s-electric-vehicles-adopt-north-american-charging-standard-nacs-14428477, 403 to fetcher, search excerpt only): first NACS Kias are the 2025 EV6 and 2026 EV9; EV6, EV9, Niro EV and current Soul EV owners can buy an accessory adapter at Kia dealers in Canada.
